title: Chapter 310: A Strange Idea
content:
Chapter 310: A Strange Idea

On the battlefield of the demon territory, there was no need for the plague assistance of the six-star Zerg scorpion. The demon star-level troops of tens of millions were pushed flat by the Zerg army.

There were three areas in the demon territory where tens of millions of star-level troops were gathered. The Zerg air force pushed them one by one and wiped out all the core troops in the demon territory.

The ten Zerg air forces separated again and swept the demon army of a certain size in the large demon territory.

In this process, the real strong men of the demon tribe have been restrained and did not participate in the war.

The Zerg army did not take the initiative to attack the seven-star strong men of the demon tribe, allowing them to watch the battle and obtain intelligence from the Zerg army.

In the areas swept by the Zerg air force, the remaining demon army and territory population were handed over to the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, as well as the Daxia army and the alliance army that were undergoing trials in the demon territory.

The Daxia army led by Wu Cong is constantly growing by constantly absorbing troops from the recovered demon cities.

The Alliance army is also constantly absorbing troops from various territories of the Alliance and growing rapidly.

With the strong support of the Zerg's Nine Transformations of the Silkworm and the Zerg's biological colonization suits, they are growing every moment in the perfect trial field of the Demon Territory and under the blessing of the world's rules and authority.

The Zerg has now conquered the entire Demon Territory, and they will have a wider trial space.

The armies of various races in the Southern Free Land, which were originally confronting the Demon Army, only realized that the Zerg had conquered the powerful Demon Territory on the opposite side when they saw that the large garrison of the Demon Race on the opposite side was surrounded and annihilated by the Zerg Army.

Many of the various races in the Southern Free Land are well-informed and have passed on the news about the Zerg. When facing the Zerg Army, they behaved very restrained and did not seize the territory.

The two sides of the same camp are at peace.

…

To the east of the demon territory are other races in the evil god camp. For the current Zerg, the strength of those races is not worth mentioning. As long as the troops are sufficient, they can fight all the way.

Of course, these races are not alone. Behind them is the evil god camp. Now the demons blocking the front have retreated, leaving a gap in the battle line of the entire camp. The evil god camp will definitely find a way to fill it.

The Zerg army quickly annihilated the main demon army in the demon territory and actually controlled the entire territory of the demon. Such a huge territory added to the Zerg control range requires a large number of Zerg puppies for actual control.

Now the Zerg army is going to attack the east of the demon territory again, and the number of Zerg puppies and type 3 Zerg poisonous ray scorpions is more. A large number of Zerg puppies in the forbidden territory of the Zerg began to pour into the demon territory.

When the strong men of the demon tribe dismantled the last space transmission channel in the demon territory, it marked that the demon tribe had completely abandoned this territory.

Wu Qing immediately sensed that the Zerg was one step closer to obtaining the status of a large tribe.

Compared with the harvest on the desert battlefield, the harvest this time was less than half, which shows that the loss of the demons was not great.

The road for the Zerg to gain the status of a great tribe is still very long. The Zerg army can only kill the territories of other races in the evil god camp in the east without stopping.

In the early stage of attacking the territories of other races in the evil god camp, a large number of Zerg hosts continued to go deep and find out some basic situations.

A total of eleven Zerg air forces were divided into four, and forty-four teams were dispersed into the territories of other races in the evil god camp.

Each Zerg air force team attacked the territory city that threatened the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, clearing obstacles for the Zerg ground forces.

With 2,500 five-star Zerg air guards and 2,500 five-star Zerg Devourers, the Zerg air force team of ordinary races in the evil god camp could not resist it at all.

A Zerg air force team can turn a city with millions of people into ruins in a very short time.

Forty-four Zerg air force squads swept around like locusts, clearing obstacles for the Zerg ground forces that followed.

Because the Zerg army moved too quickly, the territories of the various races in the Evil God camp that were attacked had no time to react, and they were annihilated.

The Evil God camp has always had an advantage in the battle with the local race camp, and there are rarely counterattacks from the local race camp.

Especially in this area near the Endless Mountains, there are demons, bear goblins and other large tribes in the Evil God camp. The Evil God camp continues to advance the front line, and the joint army of the Southern Free Land opposite is in a state of continuous retreat.

Such a counterattack by the Zerg army is very unexpected.

A large number of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions entered this area from the ground and began to carry out a carpet sweep.

The Zerg army seized the opportunity and rushed forward. In a very short time, it destroyed the territories of dozens of races of the Evil God camp.

The various races in the evil god camp finally reacted and organized some coalition forces to defend, but these were all in vain under the powerful offensive of the Zerg army.

Only when the evil god camp really reacts and the armies of the major races arrive, maybe they can curb the offensive of the Zerg army.

Wu Qing wants to use this time difference to destroy more territories of the races in the evil god camp.

…

In the ancient desert territory, the main battle has ended, and the remaining small-scale battles can be handed over to the Zerg Puppies and Type III Zerg Poisonous Ray Scorpions.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading the exciting content!

The Zerg host walked out of the ancient desert territory. There was still a vast desert outside, but it had lost the effect of the lord's protection, and there were also countless weird things at night.

Wu Qing saw the weird creatures that appeared from time to time on the desert in the night through the Zerg host that stayed in the dark, and it felt very strange.

On the desert, it was all bare yellow sand, so it was particularly clear.

All kinds of indescribable twisted creatures appeared on the yellow sand in various weird ways.

Under the yellow sand, there were constant movements.

In the night wind, there were whispers and weird screams.

It looked very lively.

Wu Qing has now recovered to the strength of eight stars, and these weird things have no effect on him.

"I don't know if the rules of the world will allow me to destroy these weirds!"

"When I first arrived in this world, it should be because I was in the forbidden land. The mysterious weird power was too terrifying!"

"The native races in this world basically don't discuss, record, or provoke weirds, and there is no way to refer to other people's experience!"

"These weirds look mysterious, but they are not strong. The armies of other races will be afraid of them, but the Zerg army may not be afraid!"

"Before, the strength did not allow it, and they were afraid of attracting powerful weirds and ending badly. With the current strength of the Zerg, in this desert far away from the forbidden land, maybe they can fight the weirdness of this world head-on!"

Wu Qing actually wanted to fight the weirdness head-on for a long time, but the Zerg was too weak before, and they were in an area close to the forbidden land. The goblins and the Naga tribes hinted at the terrifying weirdness of the Endless Mountains, so he didn't put this idea into action.

Now that the Zerg has greatly increased its strength and is far away from the forbidden land, Wu Qing thinks this idea is very feasible.

If killing Weird can also promote the progress of the Zerg to obtain the status of a major clan, then the Zerg will no longer have to worry about finding a suitable enemy.

Actively attacking the territory of the evil god camp, the enemy is too scattered, and the Zerg sent a large number of troops, but the gains are very limited.

Waiting for the evil god camp to gather a large army will take a lot of time, and the Zerg can't wait.

The clan lands and core battlefields of the major clans in the evil god camp are distributed all over the world, and the Zerg has no way to find them now.

Without a complete map, in this world full of space transmission channels, it is really impossible to tell the east, south, west and north.

Wu Qing and the Naga tribe still can't figure out where this ancient desert territory is in this world.

Wu Qing has been keeping the alien race, a super clan in the evil god camp, because he is afraid of a hard fight. If the alien race retreats directly, it will be difficult for the Zerg to find such an excellent enemy to meet the test of the world rules.

…

Wu Qing, who had made up his mind, sent the ten air forces that had been resting on the desert battlefield to the edge of the ancient desert territory to assemble. A large number of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous scorpions also rushed in this direction.

For the sake of safety, the Zerg used the same method to get the wool of the weird at the beginning. First, the Zerg puppies were sent to attract the weird to appear and attack the Zerg army in the lord's protection area.

Of course, this time the attraction was not the previous small fight, but countless Zerg puppies rushed out of the lord's protection area of the ancient desert at once.

The desert under the night sky was boiling instantly. Countless weird things suddenly appeared, appeared beside the Zerg puppies in a completely unreasonable way, and launched various weird attacks on the Zerg puppies.

Physical attacks, mental attacks, energy attacks, all kinds of weird attacks were launched in various weird forms.

The various mental attacks that had the strongest and weirdest impact on ordinary troops were completely ineffective against Zerg puppies. Only those physical attacks and a small amount of energy attacks could hurt Zerg puppies.

The Zerg puppies fought back, fighting against all kinds of tangible twisted weird creatures, ignoring the mental attacks of those invisible weird creatures.

The five-star Zerg Devourer of the Zerg Air Force launched a slime attack, and a large number of weird creatures turned into light and disappeared. Those invisible mental weird creatures were also hurt, howling constantly, and gradually turned into nothingness.

The five-star Zerg Air Guards did not need to open fire, as the strength of these weird creatures in front of them was still too weak.

Those five-star Zerg Devourers were just wasting their combat power, because the one-star Zerg puppies could fight the current weird creatures on par.
